full_judgment:
Md. Ruhul Amin CJ: This petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated June 20th June 2005 of a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 2783 of 2004 discharging the Rule obtained upon an application filed under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure seeking quashing of the proceedings of C.R. Case No. 47/2003 (Jhal) of the Court of Magistrate, 1st Class, Jhalakathi under sections 406/420 of the Penal Code. 

 2. The case of the complainant, in short, is that he paid Tk. 3,00,000/- to the petitioner, on October 9, 2001, who assured the complainant to send his brother to Foreign country for employment, that by a letter the petitioner expressed his inability to send the complainant's brother to Itali and thereupon complainant asked for return of the money received and that accused persons named in the petition of complaint issued cheque for amount of Tk. 3,00,000/- on August 3, 2002, that the complainant presented the cheque on August 4, 2002 but it was not honoured, that the complainant again presented the cheque on August 5, 2002 and August 11, 2002 and on those days cheque was also not honoured since no arrangement was made by the account holder for payment of the amount mentioned in the cheque, that the complainant lastly presented the cheque on August 14, 2002 and the same was returned to the complainant with the comment "referred to drawer", that one of the accused being the relative of the complainant he asked for time with the expectation of returning the money received by the accused persons, but to his frustration on January 1, 2003 accused persons finally refused to pay back the money received from the complainant for sending his brother to Itali, that the Court of Magistrate after completion of the procedure sent the petition of complaint for inquiry and report to the local Commissioner of Jhalakathi Pourashava and on receipt of the report from the local Commissioner of Jhalakathi Pourashava the Court of Magistrate took cognizance against the petitioner and others under sections 406/420 of the Penal Code and issued warrant of arrest, that the police in execution of the warrant arrested the accused persons and produced them before the Court, that the accused persons were enlarged on bail and thereafter the petitioner herein moved the High Court Division by filing application under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure seeking quashing of the proceedings of C.R. Case No. 47 of 2003 of the Court of Magistrate, Jhalakathi.
